headline: Wardens Reclaim Gutter And Advance West As Stonecradle Flares
war_summary: Warden forces have retaken The Parras to re-establish complete dominion over The Gutter, while simultaneous pushes in Farranac Coast netted captures at Transient Valley and The Bone Haft. In Stonecradle, violent back-and-forth fighting generated five strategic base actions in two hours, leaving one position in ruins and costing more than 1,800 combined casualties. Callahan’s Passage abruptly awoke from quietude into a raging combat sector, suffering over 1,600 casualties in the two-hour span as Colonial losses mounted sharply. Linn of Mercy continues its grueling struggle with over 1,600 recent dead around Rotdust and Lathair, while Weathered Expanse sustained another 1,650 casualties despite stalling base changes. Across the western waters, Colonials maintained their grip on Fort Ember in Fisherman’s Row after brief contesting. In sharp contrast to earlier reports, fighting has dried up across Dead Lands, Nevish Line, and Marban Hollow, shifting the weight of battle squarely to the central and northwestern sectors.
